newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks lifted by positive inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks lifted by positive inflation data.

text.p: Madrid stock indices closed at historic highs again on Thursday, buoyed by positive inflation data but analysts said they could not rule out the possibility of a correction from these high levels.
The general index closed 1.89 points, 0.49 percent, higher at 389.94. Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed up 23.01 points, 0.51 percent, at 4,492.91.

Telefonica proved to be the most active stock, accounting for 18.67 percent of total volume and boosting indices with a 50 peseta rise to 2,790. The company is due to announce its results for the first nine months of 1996 on Friday.
"The market is holding firm, although with the Ibex approaching 4,500 and the general index 390, it could dip in the short term," said one trader.
Consumer price data came in lower than expected in early trade, prompting shares to rally on the possibility of a rate cut before year end.
October CPI rose 0.1 percent month-on-month. A Reuters poll of economists had forecast a 0.2 percent rise.
Among individual stocks, Telepizza slipped 50 pesetas to 3,050 after climbing sharply on Thursday, its first day of trading on the market.
Repsol climbed 35 pesetas to 4,350 and Endesa gained 10 pesetas to 8.090.
